sentences.text:
An Application For Anticipatory Bail ... vs In Re : Shyam Sundar
Agarwal (Jindal( on 2 September, 2014
Author: Pranab Kumar Chattopadhyay

Bench: Pranab Kumar Chattopadhyay  1 02.09.2014 DC.
C. R. M. 8899 of 2014

In the matter of: An Application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 01.08.2014 in connection with Siliguri Police Station Case No.
566 of 2014 dated 09. 07. 2014 under Sections 272/273/420/34 of the I.P.C read with Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
And In re : Shyam Sundar Agarwal (Jindal(. .. . .. . . .
....................petitioner vs. State of West Bengal..................for Opposite Party Mr. Debasish Roy Mr.
Niladri Banerjee Ms. Soma Kar Ghosh..........for petitioner Mr. Sabir Ahmed.........for the State Heard the learned Advocate of both the parties.

Considering the materials in the case diary produced before us and having regard to the gravity of the offences alleged against the petitioner, we are not inclined to allow the prayer of the petitioner under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is refused and the application for anticipatory bail is rejected.

(Pranab Kumar Chattopadhyay-J.) ( Sudip Ahluwalia-J.)
